title: Validated sign-up form
summary: Use controlled inputs, validate on submit and show accessible errors.
prompt: Finish `SignupForm`. It has controlled "Email" and "Password" inputs and a "Sign up" submit button. On submit, call `preventDefault()` and validate: the email must contain "@", and the password needs at least 8 characters. Show each failure in an element with `role="alert"`. Call `onSubmit({ email, password })` only when both are valid.
hints: Handle `onSubmit` on the `<form>` rather than `onClick` on the button, so Enter works too.
Collect errors into an array and render them; submit only when the array is empty.
